items.label: RFID Security
items.value: This crossbody bag features five built-in RFID-blocking card slots in the main compartment to protect your credit cards and ID from electronic theft

items.label: Compact & Practical
items.value: Measuring 9.8" x 3.5" x 6" with a 3.4L capacity, this small purse is perfect for daily essentials and travel. It is made from soft, lightweight, and stylish water-resistant nylon, suitable for any occasion

items.label: Lightweight & Portable
items.value: Weighing only 0.33 lbs, this mini crossbody bag keeps you light and free. It features a smooth zipper and an adjustable strap for versatile wearing—over the shoulder, across the body, or as a chest bag

items.label: Organized & Roomy
items.value: Designed with multiple pockets to keep everything in order. The main compartment includes card slots and a zippered pocket for valuables, plus easy-access front and secure back pockets for on-the-go convenience

items.label: Versatile & Gift-Ready
items.value: Its cute and compact design makes it an ideal gift for women of all ages. This nylon crossbody bag can be used as a travel purse, everyday handbag, shoulder bag, or mini tote. Perfect for shopping, outings, travel, commuting, sports, gym workouts, outdoor activities, cycling, and hiking
